responsibility: Declares the Resolver2_0 Late pass that performs ordinary post-macro Rust name resolution over expressions, patterns, and type references. The class derives from DefaultResolver, exposes a crate-level go entry point, provides hooks for introducing new local labels and bindings, and declares the visit methods that resolve identifier expressions, value paths, type paths, and struct-expression type names using the populated NameResolutionContext.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Late resolver class, its crate entry point, builtin-type setup hook, and overrides for binding and lookup-related AST nodes; the paired .cc file contains the actual builtin registration and name-resolution behavior.
